x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Hexalith.Memories CLI (preview) — foundation tool shipped by Story 7.1.

Examples:
    memories tenant list
    memories quickstart

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Override the Memories Server endpoint URL (takes precedence over env var and config file).

options.name: --token
options.description: API token (prefer HEXALITH_MEMORIES_API_TOKEN env var; argv is visible in shell history).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit additional diagnostic output to stderr (exception type / message; never the token).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: human (default), json, table.

options.name: --telemetry
options.description: Enable OTLP trace export from the CLI (uses HEXALITH_MEMORIES_OTEL_ENDPOINT when set, otherwise the local Aspire OTLP endpoint http://localhost:18889). Off by default to preserve cold-start latency.

commands.name: tenant
commands.description:
Tenant administration commands.

Example:
    memories tenant list

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all tenants registered on the server.

Examples:
    memories tenant list
    memories --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:5000 tenant list
    memories --format json tenant list

commands.name: config
commands.description:
Inspect and diagnose CLI configuration.

Example:
    memories config show

commands.name: show
commands.description:
Print the resolved endpoint, source, and whether a token is configured.

Examples:
    memories config show
    memories config show --format json

commands.name: search
commands.description:
Search memories with three-axis hybrid fusion.

Examples:
    memories search query --tenant acme --query "first search"
    memories search inspect --tenant acme --case case-1 --id mu-abc

commands.name: query
commands.description:
Search memories using three-axis hybrid fusion (default) or a single axis.

Examples:
    memories search query --tenant acme --query "customer escalation"
    memories search query --tenant acme --query "..." --axis semantic --explain
    memories search query --tenant acme --query "..." --format json

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --case
options.description: Limit the search to a specific case.

options.name: --query
options.description: Free-text query. Required for syntactic/semantic/hybrid; optional for graph.

options.name: --axis
options.description: Search axis: syntactic, semantic, graph, or hybrid (default). [default: hybrid]

options.name: --max-results
options.description: Max rows (default: server default 10; CLI ceiling: 1000). [default: 10]

options.name: --explain
options.description: Ask the server for explain metadata (caveat + normalization methods).

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Inspect a single memory unit, including metadata origin (human/ai) and confidence (FR64).

Example:
    memories search inspect --tenant acme --case case-123 --id mu-abc

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier.

options.name: --case
options.description: Case identifier.

options.name: --id
options.description: Memory unit identifier.

commands.name: quickstart
commands.description:
Guided quickstart: verify prerequisites, print the stack boot command, probe server health, provision a sample tenant, ingest a sample document, and run a validation search.

Examples:
    memories quickstart
    memories quickstart --tenant acme-quickstart
    memories quickstart --dry-run --format json
    memories quickstart --skip-prereq-check --skip-boot-check

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier for the sample (default: 'quickstart-YYYYMMDD' in UTC — collides across runs on the same day by design for idempotent rerun per ADR-7.4-004; pass a unique id if running against a shared endpoint).

options.name: --skip-boot-check
options.description: Skip the server-reachability probe (step 3). Useful when a fixture already guarantees the server is up.

options.name: --skip-prereq-check
options.description: Skip the Docker/.NET/port prerequisite block (step 1). Useful in container-based CI where Docker-on-Docker is unavailable.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print every step and the exact action it would perform without mutating any state. Exits 0.

commands.name: status
commands.description:
Inspect server + pipeline status (telemetry summary, indexes, queue depth).

Example:
    memories status telemetry --tenant acme

commands.name: telemetry
commands.description:
Show per-tenant telemetry summary (index sizes, search counters, ingestion queue depth).

Examples:
    memories status telemetry --tenant acme
    memories status telemetry --tenant acme --format json

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

commands.name: consistency
commands.description:
Audit and repair index/graph consistency across the three backends (Story 8.2).

Examples:
    memories consistency verify --tenant acme
    memories consistency inspect --tenant acme --id 01HM5Q9WXGK6T8Q4Z5Y6V7W8X9
    memories consistency repair --tenant acme --yes

commands.name: verify
commands.description:
Schedule a consistency-verification workflow for a tenant. Reports per-unit discrepancies
across the three backends (RediSearch, Redis Vector, FalkorDB).

Examples:
    memories consistency verify --tenant acme
    memories consistency verify --tenant acme --wait
    memories consistency verify --tenant acme --batch-size 1000 --wait

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Optional per-batch fan-out size (10-5000). Default is 500.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Poll workflow status until completion (up to 30 minutes).

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Inspect consistency for a single memory unit across all three backends.

Example:
    memories consistency inspect --tenant acme --id 01HM5Q9WXGK6T8Q4Z5Y6V7W8X9

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --id
options.description: Memory unit identifier (26-char Crockford-base32 ULID or legacy GUID).

commands.name: repair
commands.description:
Schedule a consistency-repair workflow for a tenant. Repair is a MUTATING operation —
requires --yes to skip the interactive confirmation prompt.

Examples:
    memories consistency repair --tenant acme --yes
    memories consistency repair --tenant acme --wait --yes
    memories consistency repair --tenant acme --include-unrepairable --yes

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Optional per-batch fan-out size (10-5000). Default is 500.

options.name: --include-unrepairable
options.description: Record RepairActionRecord entries even for Unrepairable units.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Poll workflow status until completion (up to 30 minutes).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip interactive confirmation (required on non-TTY stdin).

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export memories and edges for a case or tenant as portable JSON (Story 8.3).

Examples:
    memories export case --tenant acme --case 01HM5Q9WXGK6T8Q4Z5Y6V7W8X9 --output case.json
    memories export tenant --tenant acme | jq .manifest

commands.name: case
commands.description:
Export a single case (case record + memory units + graph edges) as portable JSON.

Examples:
    memories export case --tenant acme --case 01HM5Q9WXGK6T8Q4Z5Y6V7W8X9 --output case-1.json
    memories export case --tenant acme --case 01HM5Q9WXGK6T8Q4Z5Y6V7W8X9 | jq .manifest

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --case
options.description: Case identifier (required, 26-char Crockford ULID).

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the JSON export to this file (default: stdout).

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow overwriting an existing --output file.

options.name: --allow-absolute-path
options.description: Allow --output paths outside the current working directory (safety opt-in).

commands.name: tenant
commands.description:
Export a full tenant (config + cases + memory units + graph edges) as portable JSON.

Examples:
    memories export tenant --tenant acme --output tenant.json
    memories export tenant --tenant acme | jq .manifest

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier (required).

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the JSON export to this file (default: stdout).

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow overwriting an existing --output file.

options.name: --allow-absolute-path
options.description: Allow --output paths outside the current working directory (safety opt-in).

commands.name: handlers
commands.description:
Inspect registered event handlers and detect routing mismatches (Story 9.3).

Examples:
    memories handlers list
    memories handlers mismatches --tenant acme

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List registered event handlers.

Examples:
    memories handlers list
    memories --format json handlers list

commands.name: mismatches
commands.description:
Detect handler-routing mismatches for a tenant.

Examples:
    memories handlers mismatches --tenant acme
    memories handlers mismatches --tenant acme --severity warning
    memories handlers mismatches --tenant acme --exclude-stale

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Tenant identifier to detect mismatches for (required).

options.name: --severity
options.description: Filter to info or warning severity (human/table output only).

options.name: --only-warning
options.description: Shorthand for --severity warning.

options.name: --exclude-stale
options.description: Suppress StaleHandler category entries in human/table output.

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Ingest memories from files, URLs, or directories.

commands.name: traverse
commands.description: Walk the causal graph from a seed memory.

commands.name: case
commands.description: Create, list, and manage cases.

commands.name: explore
commands.description: Interactive exploration of memories and cases.
